crossrefs.text: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.
And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
We have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, that we may understand what God has freely given us.
But if Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness.
And if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit, who lives in you.

For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this worldʼs darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!
If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.
And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.
Therefore everyone who confesses Me before men, I will also confess him before My Father in heaven.
How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.
By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption to sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
deliverance from hostile hands, that we may serve Him without fear,
in holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our lives.
Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.
You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
